story.title: Iran Threatens Strong Retaliation Against Upcoming US Sanctions
story.summary: Iran has vowed to deliver a 'devastating' response to the new sanctions package announced by the US, which Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent claims will be the toughest in history. The sanctions are set to be imposed on Monday, focusing on economic measures to reduce the need for military action.

timeline_highlights.title: Trump Issues Threats Against Iranian Infrastructure Amid Strait of Hormuz Tensions
timeline_highlights.summary: US President Donald Trump has threatened to target Iranian bridges and power plants in retaliation for any attacks on ships in the Strait of Hormuz. He stated that for each ship fired upon by Iranian forces, the US would respond by destroying a corresponding piece of Iranian infrastructure. This escalation comes amid ongoing tensions in the region and rising oil prices.
key_facts: Trump threatened to destroy Iranian infrastructure for each ship attacked in the Strait of Hormuz.
The threat follows continued Iranian attacks on shipping in the region.
Oil prices have surged amid the escalating tensions.

related_stories.title: Spain Relocates Migrants from Ceuta Beach to Shelters Amid Ongoing Crisis
related_stories.summary: Spain has begun relocating hundreds of migrants from a makeshift camp on Ceuta's El Trampolín beach to temporary shelters. This action comes nearly three weeks after a mass border surge resulted in thousands of migrants living without adequate shelter in the North African enclave.

related_stories.title: First Migrants Deported from US Arrive in Liberia Under Humanitarian Agreement
related_stories.summary: The first 20 migrants deported from the United States have arrived in Liberia as part of a new agreement allowing the country to accept up to 1,200 foreign nationals over the next year. This deal is described by authorities as 'entirely humanitarian.'

related_stories.title: Israel Advances E1 West Bank Settlement Amid International Backlash
related_stories.summary: Israel has re-established the E1 settlement in the West Bank, allowing thirty families to move in, which has sparked fears among nearby Palestinian residents. The project has drawn significant international condemnation, particularly from France, Germany, the UK, and Italy, who argue that it undermines the possibility of a Palestinian state by further partitioning the occupied territory. The settlement plan, which includes over 1,200 homes, has been criticized as a violation of international law.

related_stories.title: First Group of US Deportees Arrives in Liberia Under New Agreement
related_stories.summary: Twenty deportees from the United States arrived in Liberia, marking the first group under a new agreement that could see up to 1,200 migrants sent to the West African nation. This arrangement is part of a broader immigration strategy initiated during the Trump administration.
